products.title: Three families. Endless prints.
products.intro: Every format below is produced to order — your capacity, your lid standard, your artwork. Hover a card to see the format from a second angle.
products.ctaNote: Tell us the fill and the volume. We come back with specs and pricing.

expertise.title: One line, from sheet to carton.
expertise.body: Extrusion, forming, trimming, stacking and packing run as a single line, with tooling built and maintained on site. That is what makes a custom format a scheduling question rather than a supply-chain one.

materials.title: Food-grade materials
materials.body: PP, PS, PET and PVC chosen against your fill temperature and shelf life.

moulds.title: Custom moulds
moulds.body: Your volume, diameter and stacking height. Existing formats are a starting point.

tooling.title: In-house tooling
tooling.body: Moulds cut and maintained on site, so revisions stay fast and cheap.

volume.title: Volume runs
volume.body: Planned around recurring monthly commitments, not one-off batches.

hygiene.title: Hygiene standards
hygiene.body: Documented food-contact handling from resin lot to finished carton.

leadTimes.title: Lead times
leadTimes.body: Repeat formats ship from planned stock; new tooling gets a firm date.

custom.q: Can you make a format we design ourselves?
custom.a: Yes. Tooling is built in-house, so a new diameter, height or stacking profile is a scheduling question rather than a supply-chain one. Send a drawing or a sample and we will come back with a tooling cost and a date.

moq.a: It depends on the format and whether the mould already exists. Existing formats run at a far lower minimum than new tooling. Tell us the monthly volume you expect and we will quote against it.

materials.a: PP, PS, PET and PVC. The right one depends on your fill temperature, barrier requirement and shelf life — we will recommend a material with the quote rather than default to one.

lidding.q: Do your cups take standard foil lids?
lidding.a: Every format is designed around a rolled sealing rim. Tell us the lidding equipment and foil standard you already run and we will match it.

leadTime.a: Repeat formats ship from planned stock. A new mould adds tooling time, quoted as a firm date rather than an estimate before you commit.

quote.title: Tell us what you need.
quote.body: Fill, capacity, lid standard and monthly volume are usually enough for us to quote from.
